content: Fixed connectivity self-probe deadlock (Bug 1) and bridge probe timeout (Bug 2). Root cause of both: urllib.request.urlopen is blocking and fires from inside sovereign-sse async event loop. Bug 1 fix: PID-match guard in check_status — if status.pid == os.getpid(), skip HTTP probe and return http_ok=True (the tool call itself proves liveness). Bug 2 fix: run check_all() via asyncio run_in_executor so urllib probes execute in a thread pool rather than blocking the event loop. Bridge probe now returns 200 OK instead of socket:timed_out. Both fixes land in connectivity.py and connectivity_tools.py. 2 tests added (test_self_probe_skipped_when_pid_matches_own_process, test_non_self_probe_still_runs_http_check). 52/52 tests green. Fixed by claude-sonnet-4-6[1m] in session april-2026-sonnet-bugfix.
